title: ...bring home a newly adopted dog or puppy
desc: Create a safe, stress-free environment for your new pet's first 24 hours.
todos: Pet-proof living space by securing electrical cords, plants, and small items.
Set up dedicated quiet area with bed, water bowl, and familiar blanket.
Establish immediate potty break routine outdoors or in designated area.
Schedule wellness checkup visit with local veterinarian within 7 days.
Update collar ID tags and microchip registry with your current contact info.
